messages:
alana: FYI vendor 'Heliodor' just pinged billing 6 about a surprise charge on their July invoice. They ran a data migration that unintentionally hit live inference endpoints. Asking for a partial refund + note to avoid auto-block next time.

rod: Can you drop the invoice id and sample usage lines? We'll need to check terabytes vs retainer and whether this qualifies for a one-time goodwill.

alana: INV-2025-3210. Excerpt: 
```
date,service,tokens,cost
2025-07-12,matrix-embed,1,1200
2025-07-12,api-gen,1,24000
2025-07-13,api-gen,1,8000
```
They say the bulk (24k) was a single migration job that ran for ~3 hours. Total billed was $36k; contract retainer is $15k so net charge $51k for month. They want a refund of ~$30k.

billing-bot: Found invoice INV-2025-3210. Balance: $51,000. Auto-credit threshold: $7,500. Manual approvals required above that.

rod: Ops take: (a) we can prorate the retainer for the migration window (~$9k) and (b) consider a goodwill cap of $7.5k per policy for first-time migration incidents. That'd be $16.5k total. @frank (finance manager) can you approve manual adjustment?

frank: Quick question 6 are they in a support plan that covers migration assistance? If yes, we may be more generous.

alana: They have standard SLA, not migration plan. They noted they didn't disable production keys during migration.

frank: Ok conservative approach approved: $16,500 total credit. Use acct code 5407, put memo "vendor-migrate-refund-jul25". Request they sign a short attestation and mitigation steps before we close.

rod: I'll create CM-2025-1182 for $16,500 and apply to INV-2025-3210. Attaching entry and audit note when done.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2025-1182 created for $16,500 and applied to INV-2025-3210. Audit note: "approved frank 1769994500".

natalie: I'll follow up to get their RCA + attestation and add to the vendor file. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
